title: Uniform sup-norm control for mean-zero bounded-Laplacian functions in cohomologically dominated degenerating Kähler families with Lp volume densities
author: Vincent Guedj; Tat Dat Tô

difficulty_reason: A bounded Laplacian and zero mean do not yield a family-uniform oscillation bound from the available estimates without additional density control. The authors normalize by the unknown L1 size, compare positive and negative parts with twisted Monge–Ampère potentials, and close a small-Laplacian bootstrap that forces the normalization parameter away from zero. That new comparison/contradiction step supplies the missing uniform bound beyond the cited pluripotential foundations, without adding the discarded density hypothesis.
